question: Where do you usually post these: Instagram or TikTok, YouTube, somewhere else?
why: Sets vertical or horizontal and the usual length, so this stops being a choice every time.

question: Should cuts land tight on your words, or at natural moments, like when you move, look away or the shot changes?
why: This is the biggest difference between editors. It changes where every cut goes.

question: When you stumble or restart a sentence, should I always cut it, or keep a few so it feels natural?
why: Decides how much of the real you stays in.

question: How do you like a video to start: straight into the point, or the way you started talking?
why: The first 2 seconds decide whether people keep watching.

question: Is there anything you always say or do on camera that I should never cut, or always cut?
why: Sign-offs, catchphrases and habits are part of your style or part of the noise; only you know which.

question: Is there a video, yours or anyone's, whose editing you love? Send me the link and say what you like about it.
why: One example you love teaches more than 10 questions.

question: Music under your voice: none, very quiet, or a track you pick?
why: Only asked once samples have shown you both.

question: Any names you say often, like your business, people or products, that captions should spell right?
why: Captions spell these right from then on.

question: When you watch one of your finished videos, what makes it feel like yours?
why: The thing no default can guess. It shapes every choice after this.
